ears_text: The project's VERSION file shall contain a semantic version in the form <major>.<minor>.<patch>, optionally followed by -dev.<N> or -rc.<N>.
test_script:
import re
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

VERSION_FILE = Path("/project/VERSION")

SEMVER_RE = re.compile(r"^(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)(-(dev|rc)\.(0|[1-9]\d*))?$")


def test_version_file_is_semantic_version():
    assert VERSION_FILE.is_file(), f"VERSION file not found at {VERSION_FILE}"

    raw = VERSION_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    content = raw.strip()

    assert content, "VERSION file is empty"
    assert "\n" not in content, (
        f"VERSION file must contain a single line, got: {raw!r}"
    )
    assert SEMVER_RE.match(content), (
        f"VERSION {content!r} does not match "
        "<major>.<minor>.<patch>[-dev.<N>|-rc.<N>]"
    )
